headline: 5 Aniimo tips for beginners
title: 5 Aniimo Beginner Tips | Things I Wish I Knew | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Five Aniimo tips I wish I knew sooner. One: learn Twining early, it's how you get around Idyll. Two: catch lots of different species, not just fighters. Three: explore at different times and in different weather, because new Aniimo appear. Four: fill every Hatchinator before you log off, eggs keep hatching while you're away. Five: missed Aniipods come back, so don't panic when you miss. Follow for more Aniimo tips!
description: 5 Aniimo beginner tips: learn Twining early, catch many different species, explore in different weather and times of day, fill your Hatchinators before logging off, and don't worry about missed Aniipods - they come back.
